objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined regulation or regulation relating to a business process

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedure within a framework or process sequence with responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed steps for special work procedures with associated forms and checklists

objs.name: document
objs.description: Generic document object that can be of various types managed in the system

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document supplement not subject to release cycle of main document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with main document and subject to versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to an existing document

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to extend validity of a document after periodic check

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User with write permissions who creates and edits document

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User with personal change rights on a document

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User who checks document content for technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User responsible for approving and releasing document to readers

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User with read-only permissions to view approved documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User who translates released document content into another language

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: User group with read access to archived documents

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Record of users and groups receiving document access and notifications

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participant

objs.name: version
objs.description: Released iteration of a document with status and validity dates

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined format used as basis for creating new documents

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Activity assigned to user within approval process

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Record of system-tracked changes and actions on documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with assigned permissions and roles

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new document object with document type and optional template selection

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using editing client

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Creation and modification of document properties and attributes

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document to PDF format after saving

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment of controlled document as supplement to main document

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of uncontrolled supplement information to document

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participant during approval process

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of document by releaser

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send document notification to assigned users and groups

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request workflow-supported acknowledgement from assigned users and groups

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by user of document receipt

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal check of document content by reviewer

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of proposed amendment without affecting version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Processing of change proposal creating new document version

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version from released document with retained data

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approval that document remains valid in current version

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request when document reaches 30 days before expiry

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User creation of request to invalidate and archive document

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declaration of document as invalid and withdrawal from circulation

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Revocation of authorizations with retention in archive

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of previously invalidated document creating new version

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Technical and formal check of translated document by reviewer

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and publication of translated document version

o2o.description: Guideline implements or operates under Policy
Procedural Instruction defines specific execution of Guideline framework
Work Instruction provides detailed steps for Procedural Instruction sub-processes
Attachment is controlled supplement to Document
Additional Information is uncontrolled supplement to Document
Change Proposal is proposed amendment to Document
Version is released iteration of Document
Distribution List specifies user access for Document
Archive Group is specialized User Group
Validity Extension Request is associated with Document
Override Request is associated with Document
Reactivation Request is associated with Document
Document Template is basis for Document creation

o2e.description: Convert to PDF produces Document in PDF format
Add Additional Information produces Additional Information
Distribute by Email notifies about Document
Distribute for Acknowledgement requests confirmation from Document
Create Change Proposal produces Change Proposal
Implement Change Proposal creates Document Version
Implement Change Proposal processes Change Proposal
Revise Document creates new Document Version
Create Validity Extension Request produces request
Create Validity Extension Request targets Document
Reactivate Document creates new Document Version
